taskclause-debt.json.label: taskclause
taskclause-debt.json.what: A day’s stake has to say what the player decides, in the “Today you …” shape.
taskclause-debt.json.owed: day(s) whose stake never says what you decide

stakelength-debt.json.label: stakelength
stakelength-debt.json.what: The opening blurb — stake plus any briefing that says something the stake did not — runs to four sentences at most.

namefree-debt.json.label: namefree
namefree-debt.json.what: A plan card and a debrief name nobody. Names belong on the call’s own reason, at the moment the person is standing in front of you.
namefree-debt.json.owed: day(s) naming somebody on the plan card or the debrief

openinglength-debt.json.label: openinglength
openinglength-debt.json.what: The opening card runs to five sentences at most — one more than a day card, because it carries four beats and a day card carries one. Counted by the same splitter as the day cap.

segue-drama-debt.json.label: segue-drama
segue-drama-debt.json.what: A closing card has to turn: a complication or a forced consequence, in any wording, with something concrete at risk — and it may not simply echo the next stake or the day’s own takeaway.
segue-drama-debt.json.owed: closing card(s) with no turn in them

seguegrade-debt.json.label: seguegrade
seguegrade-debt.json.what: A closing card reads at grade 8 or below — a flat ceiling rather than the campaign’s own audience grade, since a closing card motivates rather than teaches.

plaincards-debt.json.label: plainCards
plaincards-debt.json.rule: All three are high-water marks. plainCards fails this campaign if any of them rises. They only ever fall, and they fall by rewriting cards and re-banking with --write-debt.

plainquestions-debt.json.label: plainQuestions
plainquestions-debt.json.rule: Three of the six are gated and three are only reported, and the asymmetry is the point. long and wps may not rise; spw may not fall, because a reading grade bought by deleting the course’s vocabulary is the one thing the accessibility pass forbids. The grade itself is reported, never gated.
